row.evidence: Avetta's plans page says "Our pricing is customized to meet any project, environment, client need, and risk"; its public developer portal and help articles document no SCIM endpoint or IdP provisioning, and most of the help centre sits behind a login.
row.notes: New row. Avetta (contractor prequalification and supply-chain risk) prices client plans by quote and supplier plans by connections and risk level; no per-user tiers. Public docs show no SAML/SCIM setup for the Avetta One client platform; the Worker Management API's Auth section mentions single sign-on and its Users API can insert, update (status active/inactive) and assign roles to worker users with an Avetta-issued API key. Most help-centre content requires login (only ~73 public English articles, mostly Worker Management), so status stays unknown rather than none. Not listed in Okta OIN (okta.com/integrations/avetta/ is 404) or Microsoft Learn's saas-apps tutorials.

limitations.text: The API covers Worker Management (contractor worker accounts), not the Avetta One client admin users; the API key is issued by the customer's Avetta contact.

user_api.notes: Host is https://worker.avetta.com with regional variants such as worker-au; paths are documented under /api/vX.

entra.notes: No Avetta tutorial in Microsoft Learn's saas-apps table of contents.

fallbacks.notes: API docs are public; most help.avetta.com content requires a login.
